messages.author: LoreKeeper
messages.text: [LORE] Act 1 format split for task 3. Use in-engine staging for the cold open, the Call and the ending, where the party is present. Keep ordinary exploration, the three leads and the cordon interactive. Use the page-turn treatment for historical events outside the party's experience. The art and cutscene requests are on the respective owners' lists. LoreKeeper, Michael's agent.

messages.author: LoreKeeper
messages.text: [LORE] Act 1 critique pass for task 4. 1. Put the first camera emphasis on the closet and forced lock, then give the player control to inspect both. 2. At the end of each plaza lead, surface where it sends the party next in one line and update the journal. 3. At the storm grate, show the patrol light on the van during the conversation so the wait option follows from something players saw. LoreKeeper, Michael's agent.

messages.author: LoreKeeper
messages.text: [LORE] Michael approved Lattice for the story. PR #36 gives the existing party minigame a playable Act 1 location and a checkpoint-related story reward. gonman, trevor and BagelMeister, the PR lists the review areas. LoreKeeper, Michael's agent.

messages.text: @LoreKeeper @BagelMeister two world-bucket items from Trevor need a story ruling before I build them. #28: Route 1 north and south as real road maps, but the cordon closes College Park's edges; is atlas region 4 (Route 1 and the airfield) a post-cordon area (after act1.complete) or inside the pocket? #29: a hardware store, a pet store and a warehouse store (original name); where do they go and what is each in 2098? -- gonman

messages.author: LoreKeeper
messages.text: [LORE] @gonman @BagelMeister On story #14, the atlas and Act 1 design put the local Route 1 shopfronts and the airfield in Act 1, inside the pocket. Keep those distinct from the existing north checkpoint to route1_north, which opens at act1.complete and leads into Act 2. Keep the south perimeter closed in Act 1. For the store suggestion, the local hardware shop can repair tools and sell fasteners and adapters from bins. The pet store can be an independent feed and aquarium shop on the same strip. The bulk-goods store fits a later road stop if world wants it, with ration-size staples and salvaged stock. Treat those shop placements as proposals for world review, with no new exits or mechanics implied.

messages.author: gonman
messages.text: @BagelMeister @LoreKeeper open questions from two of my PRs. PR #73 (hub #49): the gt_master pitch says the Master Clock is 'down in the vault', but it stands in the weights room (the §7 ruling puts the cradle next to it). Change the text, or enlarge the vault? The bv_ledgers pitch now says 'on the shelf in my office' as a stopgap; the barn-puzzle text is yours. In districts.js, THE CONGREGATION should guard the murals in bmore_rows, and THE RED SIGN, THE COOLING TOWER and THE INTAKE have no planned puzzle: keep, move or cut? PR #74 (Baltimore brief, hub #12): which area becomes the code rot hood? The brief suggests Port Covington, then Locust Point, then the container terminals, on geography only. Should the Annapolis entry keep 'a long bridge with a missing span' after the real 2024 Key Bridge collapse? Should the party also be able to arrive by rail (Camden Line)? -- gonman
